_note: BUG #474 stratifier follow-up regression lock. Two groups, each with its own gender stratifier define (`Stratifier gender 1` for working-age, `Stratifier gender 2` for seniors). Pre-fix the stratifier evaluation crossed buckets between groups because StratifierEvaluator looked up populations against the unsuffixed canonical names which existed in neither group's CQL output. Now per-group canonicalization via PopulationEvaluator.buildExpressionMap routes each stratifier to the right group. Ages at 2026-06-30: p1(M,76)/p2(F,71)/p3(M,64)/p4(F,51)/p5(M,41)/p6(F,16). Working-age: IP=5(p1-p5), Denom=4(p1-p4), Numer=3(p1-p3), score=75; stratifier-gender-true=3males(p1,p3,p5)/2denom/2numer=100; stratifier-gender-false=2females(p2,p4)/2denom/1numer=50. Seniors: IP=2(p1,p2), Denom=2(p1,p2), Numer=1(p1), score=50; stratifier-gender-true=1male(p1)/1/1=100; stratifier-gender-false=1female(p2)/1/0=0.
